name: bifrost-ci-tools
description: Pinned CI-only CLI tooling (newman). Not published, not part of the product build. Installed with `npm ci` so package-lock.json's integrity hashes are enforced, which is what OpenSSF Scorecard's Pinned-Dependencies check requires; a bare `npm install -g newman@x` pins the version but verifies nothing.
overridesRationale: newman pins vulnerable transitive deps (handlebars, lodash, node-forge, flatted, underscore, qs, jose, uuid, csv-parse). Patched registry releases are forced where available. csv-parse-compat adapts the patched parser's export and relax_quotes option to Newman's v4 API. node-forge has no patched release for GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv: node-forge-compat uses Node crypto for the RSA key conversion APIs consumed by postman-runtime's ASAP authorizer. micromatch-compat replaces the HTML reporter's glob matcher with Picomatch and a nesting bound, removing the unpatched braces dependency (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). These adapters support only the APIs used by the pinned consumers; review them when upgrading Newman or its reporter. npm test covers CSV parsing, glob behavior, ASAP signing and HTML report generation. Drop overrides when upstream dependencies no longer need them.
